description: Angular helps you build web apps from small parts called components. Think of each part as a building block for a page. Start by showing a name, then count button clicks. Later, learn forms, page links, shared data and simple tests. Learn HTML, CSS and basic TypeScript first. You will run these examples in an Angular project on your computer.
versionNote: Targets Angular 22: standalone components, signals, zoneless by default and built-in control flow. Older syntax such as NgModules and *ngIf is mentioned only so that you can recognise it.
whatYouWillLearn: Build a page from small components
Show values and react to button clicks
Link pages and collect form answers
Check your work with simple tests
learningObjectives: Explain what an Angular component is
Show a name in a heading
Use a signal to keep a changing score

seo.title: Angular Tutorial: Learn with Small Steps
seo.description: Learn Angular with small lessons on components, templates, signals, forms and page links. Follow worked examples, then try exercises and a quiz.
